messages:
mira: Quick UX check updated the on-prem preflight to add compact status chips, an inline tooltip, and a 'Download diagnostic bundle' CTA. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/uvwx1234/onprem-preflight-compact. Can folks eyeball keyboard flow, SR announcements, and copy? jamal: Loaded the mock. Nice reduction in noise. Two issues: focus jumps when chip state changes (pass -> fail) because we replace the chip node, and the download CTA disappears when details panel expands. sophia: For screen readers use an offscreen live region (role="status" aria-live="polite") and avoid focus steals. If there's a critical failure we can use assertive for one short message. Also the yellow warning chip fails contrast for small text; either darken or add bold label + icon. alex: Implementation notes: keep DOM nodes stable (use data-probe-id) and toggle classes instead of removing elements. Reserve min-width on chips to prevent width shifts. For the download bundle, keep the button in flow and show a progress state rather than re-rendering. riley: Copy tweaks: change CTA "Run probes" -> "Start network check"; small action "Fix" -> "Open troubleshooting guide"; download label -> "Download diagnostic bundle". For fallback text swap vague "try again later" with steps: "1) Open diagnostics 2) Verify egress IPs 3) Retry network check". jamal: Small aria snippet suggestion: ```
``` Then call `probeLive.textContent = 'Network check failed: egress-ssh probe'` briefly. Avoid flooding updates. sophia: Keyboard behavior: if a keyboard user expands the details panel focus should move into the panel; if expansion is automatic keep focus stable and rely on the live region. Ensure Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the triggering header. alex: Also map common HTTP errors to hints: 504 -> "Gateway timed out try increasing probe timeout or run the quick-probe"; timeout -> "Connection timed out download diagnostics to investigate". I'll draft a tiny RFC for the mapping. preview-bot: preview-bot: preview build for branch preflight-compact-a11y is live: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/preflight-compact-a11y includes live region, stable keys, min-width chips, and download streaming state. Smoke test encouraged. mira: Action items: jamal keep nodes stable + min-width chips; sophia run VO + keyboard checks and report contrast failures; alex draft RFC mapping errors -> suggested actions; riley update Figma copy. I'll close and reopen if regressions appear. Thanks :thumbsup:
